SELECT l.slug, l.fee_per_player, t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS deadline, o.name AS organiser, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'max_teams', d.max_teams, 'squad_max', d.squad_max, 'max_age', d.max_age, 'approved', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries x WHERE x.division_id = d.id AND x.status = 'APPROVED'))) FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', e.id, 'status', e.status, 'division_id', e.division_id, 'team', tm.name, 'team_code', tm.code, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key, 'area', tm.area, 'coach', u.name, 'coach_phone', u.phone, 'amount', e.amount, 'paid_players', e.paid_players, 'utr', e.utr, 'proof_key', e.proof_key, 'reject_reason', e.reject_reason, 'web', e.manage_key_hash IS NOT NULL, 'registered', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(e.created_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), 'reviewed', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(e.reviewed_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), 'waiting', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members w WHERE w.team_id = tm.id AND w.status = 'PENDING'), 'payments', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('players', p.players, 'amount', p.amount, 'utr', p.utr, 'proof_key', p.proof_key, 'at', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(p.created_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'))) FROM entry_payments p WHERE p.entry_id = e.id), 'squad', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name', COALESCE(au.name, m.guest_name), 'birthdate', DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(au.birthdate, m.guest_birthdate), '%Y-%m-%d'), 'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(au.birthdate, m.guest_birthdate), t.start_date), 'gender', COALESCE(au.gender, m.guest_gender), 'jersey', COALESCE(ep.jersey_number, m.jersey_number, au.jersey_number), 'parent_phone', m.parent_phone, 'photo_key', COALESCE(m.guest_photo_key, au.photo_key))) FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members m ON m.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users au ON au.id = m.user_id WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id))) FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id JOIN app_users u ON u.id = e.registered_by WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id) AS entries FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE l.slug = $1
